_note: Starting hyperparameters reported in primary sources, used in Figure 3 and Table 5. Each entry states its source and setting; none is an author recommendation.

entries.text: QLoRA: r = 64, alpha = 16, LoRA on all linear layers; LR 2e-4 (7B, 13B) or 1e-4 (33B, 65B); dropout 0.1 (up to 13B) or 0.05; max grad norm 0.3; constant LR schedule
entries.source: Dettmers et al. (2023), Appendix B.2 and Table 9

entries.text: With LoRA on all linear layers, rank r had little effect on final performance
entries.source: Dettmers et al. (2023), Appendix A.1, Figure 4

entries.text: On GPT-3 175B, ranks as small as 1 sufficed when adapting both Wq and Wv; Wq alone needed a larger r
LoRA+: learning rate of B about 16x that of A for RoBERTa, about 2x to 4x for Llama-7B
In code and math domains LoRA substantially underperformed full fine-tuning in standard low-rank settings
entries.setting: Llama-2-7B, continued pre-training and instruction fine-tuning
